achievements.name: The Shadow strikes
achievements.description: Successfully complete the mission “The Shadow of Absolute Evil”.

achievements.name: Death and destruction!
achievements.description: Destroy 9 Heroes with Thalya's “Fire Bomb” in the mission “The Shadow of Absolute Evil”.

achievements.name: Shadow hunter
achievements.description: Don’t let the Shadow take any damage from light in the mission “The Shadow of Absolute Evil”.

achievements.name: Twistram is devastated
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Twistram in Ruins”.

achievements.name: The Evilest Evil
achievements.description: Collect a total of 1000 Evilness in the mission “Twistram in Ruins”.

achievements.name: No one has to die today!
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Twistram in Ruins” without losing more than 3 creatures.

achievements.name: The Gehenna Stones
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Gehenna Stones”.

achievements.name: The Stones’ Power
achievements.description: Kill at least 15 Heroes using the Stones’ magic in the mission “The Gehenna Stones”.

achievements.name: The White Knight
achievements.description: Don’t let Thalya's Life Energy fall below 75% during the mission “The Gehenna Stones”.

achievements.name: The Swamplanders from the swamplands
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Ashspring Swamplands”.

achievements.name: Braiiiiins!
achievements.description: Awaken at least 98 Undead in the mission “The Ashspring Swamplands”.

achievements.name: Night of the Living Dead (on Speed)
achievements.description: Conquer all Graveyards in less than 25 minutes in the mission “The Ashspring Swamplands”.

achievements.name: Rusty Steel
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Battle of Steelsmith”.

achievements.name: The One-Huge-Army-Building Evil
achievements.description: Own at least 15 creatures at the same time in the mission “The Battle of Steelsmith”.

achievements.name: Hands off the Dungeonheart!
achievements.description: The Dungeonheart must not fall below 50% life in the mission “The Battle of Steelsmith”.

achievements.name: The last burger
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The End of Burgers' End”.

achievements.name: MASS-O-BOT
achievements.description: Own 5 Gob-O-Bots at any time in the mission “The End of Burgers' End”.

achievements.name: Then let them eat cake!
achievements.description: Don’t allow any deliveries to reach the city in the mission “The End of Burgers' End”.

achievements.name: A trip on sea, what fun it can be
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Crossing”.

achievements.name: Master of Traps
achievements.description: Kill at least 30 Heroes with the “Thrasher” Trap in the mission “The Crossing”.

achievements.name: Ignore The Level Designer’s Plan
achievements.description: Destroy at least 3 Hero tent camps during daylight in the mission “The Crossing”.

achievements.name: Damned good
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Prince of Hell”.

achievements.name: Factory farming
achievements.description: Hold at least 7 Heroes in the Prison at the same time in the mission “The Prince of Hell”.

achievements.name: A little something extra
achievements.description: Get all of the bonus creatures in the mission “The Prince of Hell”.

achievements.name: Stock Market Crash
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Storming of Dollaran”.

achievements.name: Spawner Killer
achievements.description: Destroy all of the Hero camps in the mission “The Storming of Dollaran”.

achievements.name: Storm And Stress
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Storming of Dollaran” in less than 40 minutes.

achievements.name: Not-So-Overproud
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The End of Yaina Overproud”.

achievements.name: We don’t have time!
achievements.description: Destroy every Arcane Tear in mission “The End of Yaina Overproud” within 60 seconds maximum.

achievements.name: Hearts are trump
achievements.description: Never let the Dungeonhearts Life Energy fall under 75% in “The End of Yaina Overproud”.

achievements.name: For a handfull of Catapults
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Once Upon A Catapult”.

achievements.name: Flat as a pancake
achievements.description: Kill 50 Heroes by Catapult bombardment in the mission “Once Upon A Catapult”.

achievements.name: I love the smell of Catapult fire!
achievements.description: Capture all of the Catapults in the mission “Once Upon A Catapult” in less than 30 minutes.

achievements.name: Ogre Solo!
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Hungry, Hungry Ogre”.

achievements.name: Thirst quencher
achievements.description: Own more than 42 Barrels of Beer at the same time in the mission “The Hungry, Hungry Ogre”.

achievements.name: Can’t stand to see an Ogre bleed
achievements.description: The Ogre in the mission “The Hungry, Hungry Ogre” must not fall below 75% Life Energy.

achievements.name: Tide Master
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Ups and Downs”.

achievements.name: Lifeguard
achievements.description: Don’t lose a single creature to the water in the mission “Ups and Downs”.

achievements.name: Please, no interruptions!
achievements.description: Stop anyone from interrupting Thalya while she contaminates the water in mission “Ups and Downs”.

achievements.name: Destroy the thing
achievements.description: Complete the mission “The Titan of Alphaas”.

achievements.name: Lifesaver
achievements.description: Don’t lose more than 8 units in the mission “The Titan of Alphaas”.

achievements.name: Chorus of damnation
achievements.description: Own at least 5 Banshees at the same time in the mission “The Titan of Alphaas”.

achievements.name: Difficult family relationships
achievements.description: Complete the mission “I Am Your Father!”.

achievements.name: This is fun, I’m going to keep doing this!
achievements.description: Sacrifice more Heroes than needed in mission “I Am Your Father!” – until the Narrator is satisfied.

achievements.name: Hearts of Iron
achievements.description: Complete the mission “I Am Your Father!” without the Dungeonheart taking any damage.

achievements.name: Angel of Fire
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Baptism of Fire”.

achievements.name: Prepare the grave
achievements.description: Don’t let the Grave Golem’s Life Energy fall below 50%.

achievements.name: Not a scratch
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Baptism of Fire” without Thalya taking any damage.

achievements.name: Where there is Light, there is Shadow
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Light and Shadow”.

achievements.name: I need a hero!
achievements.description: Kill 100 Heroes in the mission “Light and Shadow”.

achievements.name: Prison Break
achievements.description: Free Thalya in less than 45 minutes in the “Light and Shadow” mission.

achievements.name: At the foot of Mount Destiny
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Two Sides Of A Medal”.

achievements.name: Use the terrain
achievements.description: Kill 30 Heroes using an Obelisk.

achievements.name: Discoverer
achievements.description: Find the two Obelisks in less than 25 minutes.

achievements.name: The Force disturbed
achievements.description: Complete the mission “A Disturbance In The Force”.

achievements.name: Can’t stand the sight of Dark Elf blood
achievements.description: Never let Thalya's Life Energy fall below 75% during the ritual.

achievements.name: Sacrifices!
achievements.description: Sacrifice all of the Titans within 40 minutes in the mission “A Disturbance In The Force”.

achievements.name: The Victorious Evil
achievements.description: Complete the mission “Everything Has An End…”.

achievements.name: The Benevolent Evil
achievements.description: Save all of the Heroes Tanos wants to punish in the mission “Everything Has An End…”.

achievements.name: Band of Brothers
achievements.description: Don’t lose a single creature to Tanos in battle in the mission “Everything Has An End…”.
